# Stored Food (EU5 1.4 carrier of the 1.3 stored-food effects, growth included; the engine's storage growth term
# is off, NPop.FOOD_STORAGE_POP_GROWTH = 0): the effects of one stored year. pp_refresh_stored_food applies it
# with size = the province's stored years (0 to the 2-year cap), so the effects follow the store continuously.

	game_data = { category = province }
	local_population_growth = 0.006
	local_devastation_recovery = 0.003
	local_migration_attraction = 0.045
	local_monthly_prosperity = 0.0025
}

# Store lever. Low Stores: the effects of one year short of 12.0 stored months, applied with size = the years
# short (1 at an empty store). Province Food is worth more, so everything that makes it runs harder; the Grange's
# Surplus Sales dry up.
pp_low_stores = {
	game_data = { category = province }
	local_local_food_output_modifier = 0.75
	local_province_food_sales_output_modifier = -3.0
	local_victuals_output_modifier = -1.0
}

# Full Stores: the effects of one year above 12.0 stored months, applied with size = the years above (1 at the
# 24-month cap). Province Food is worth less, the land yields more of its staples for the market, and the Grange
# sells the surplus.
pp_full_stores = {
	game_data = { category = province }
	local_local_food_output_modifier = -0.75
	local_province_food_sales_output_modifier = 0.34
}

# Farm Produce (2026-10-03): on every location of a province that holds a cookshop or public_kitchen,
# applied with size = the province's worked farm and orchard levels / 40.0 (at most 1).
pp_farm_produce = {
	game_data = { category = location }
	local_local_food_output_modifier = 0.1
}
